articles.summary: Organization Labels, Featured items, and saved views make Check-ins, Forms, and Automations easier to sort and filter. Admins can now manage company-wide time off and public holidays for everyone. Form approvers now get their own Slack message and can leave a comment, and Slack user groups are ready to use.
articles.title: Dailybot | August updates: Labels, organization time off, and form approval comments · Changelog
